# China unveils world's first centaur robot that tackles rough terrain The robot is designed for deployment in steel mills, oil fields, nuclear facilities and other hazardous environments\.Run Robotics/YouTube A Chinese robotics company has unveiled what it describes as the world’s first “centaur” wheel-leg hybrid robot\.
